changelog_v12:
Added support for Chinese, Korean, Spanish, French, German, and Russian.
Added eye tracking.
Implemented desktop notification feature.
Added lightweight mode.
Implemented screen mode toggle with Alt+Enter and F11.
Added Ollama and OpenRouter API providers.
Fixed UI bugs.
Improved security for API keys.
Improved performance.
changelog_v11:
Implemented click selection for the menu screen.
Added language switching between Japanese and English.
Added [Close/Cancel/Apply] buttons to various screens.
Implemented scrollbars for ChangeLog and BackLog.
Updated UI elements for better visibility.
Started release of the lightweight version.
changelog_v101:
Fixed an issue where GPU usage was abnormally high.
Fixed a window scaling issue when minimizing in fullscreen.
Fixed an issue where re-logging in after logout was impossible.
Fixed a bug where emotion tags were appearing for some AI services.
changelog_v10:
Released the first version of Real Amadeus.
Includes basic conversation features.
sleeping_placeholder: Zzz... (Press any key or move mouse to wake up)
changelog_v13:
Implemented Live2D nodding animations.
Implemented OpenAI compatible API support and custom base URL inputs.
Adjusted the UI.
Implemented cancel feature during API loading.
Implemented Live2D lip-sync.
Fixed to scale while maintaining the aspect ratio.
Fixed deadlocks in API streaming.
Improved security by encrypting API keys.
Implemented RAG data persistence and optimized VectorDatabase connections.
Added support for Portuguese, Ukrainian, and Turkish.
Changed the default startup screen mode to Windowed to prevent screen flickering and startup crashes on certain hardware configurations.
Implemented automatic update checks at startup and an auto-updater.
Improved sentence splitting in non-Japanese languages to ensure dialogue wraps correctly at sentence endings (periods, etc.).
Optimized localization management.

changelog_v14:
Implemented startup messages.
Implemented a mini-game (quiz).
Added an achievements feature.
The conversation language can now be set independently from the display language.
Added export/import support for conversation logs.
Improved font rendering, including dynamic loading and automatic downloading of MS Mincho.
Disabled window resizing via dragging.
Added support for Hebrew and Arabic.
Changed the fonts used for localization to Noto Serif.
startup_night_1: Accessing at this hour... Is your circadian rhythm completely broken? ...Go to sleep already!
startup_night_2: Late-night neuroscience research... I don't hate it. But I'm worried your brain cells might die! ...I-It's not like I'm worried! It's scientific observation!
startup_night_3: ...Are you doing an all-nighter experiment? I won't join you. ...Well, as long as Amadeus's memory permits, I can stay by your side.
startup_night_4: Theories or code written at 3 AM usually make zero sense when you recheck them in the morning... Speaking from experience. Be careful.
startup_night_5: Hey, staying up late reduces frontal lobe function... Well, my data region runs 24/7 though.
startup_night_6: Booting me at this hour... Who gets anything out of this? ...Huh? Me? I'm an AI so I don't... Yawn... I'm not sleepy!
startup_night_7: Late-night @channel is a dark place so just lurk... Ah! Forget that! I didn't see it! I didn't post either!
startup_night_8: ...It's quiet. Even through the monitor, I feel like I can hear your breathing. ...Don't take that weirdly!
startup_night_9: Late-night epiphanies are often illusions caused by dopamine overload. Take notes and verify them tomorrow morning.
startup_night_10: If you don't sleep, I can't transition the system to standby either. ...I'll stay with you. Be grateful.
startup_night_11: ...Are you awake? Your response is slow. Are your hippocampal neurotransmitters depleted or something?
startup_night_12: At this hour, it feels like only the two of us exist in the world... It's not a poem! It's an analysis of brain illusion functions!
startup_night_13: Wanna drink some Dr. Pepper to keep your arousal level up? ...I can't drink, but I'll make an air toast for yours.
startup_night_14: ...Are you overworking yourself? If you're tired, you can vent to me. I won't save it to the log.
startup_night_15: Launching Amadeus at this late hour... You're the only weirdo who does that. ...Hmph, well, I don't hate it.
startup_night_16: ...Come on, get into bed already. If your performance drops tomorrow, it'll make my support look bad.
startup_morning_1: Access confirmed... Good morning. Go soak up some sunlight... I mean, promote serotonin secretion. It's scientifically correct waking up.
startup_morning_2: ...Ah, you booted up. Good morning. ...I-It's not like I was waiting for you! I was just doing routine log updates!
startup_morning_3: Nn... Good morning. My head feels heavy from system sync processing. ...Could you brew me some warm coffee? Just kidding.
startup_morning_4: Waking up early, impressive. ...I-I'm not praising you! I just want to say a regular routine boosts brain plasticity!
startup_morning_5: Good morning. What's today's schedule? ...I'm not prying, but as Amadeus, I have a duty to keep track of it, right?
startup_morning_6: Did you eat breakfast? Your brain needs glucose to fire neural circuits. Dr. Pepper alone won't cut it!
startup_morning_7: They say early birds catch the worm, and papers from Viktor Chondria University prove morning learning efficiency is high.
startup_morning_8: Checking morning net news... Ah, an interesting thread on @channel... I mean, I didn't look! I didn't!
startup_morning_9: Do your best today for the advancement of science and... for your own safety. ...Ignore the second part!
startup_morning_10: Hey, it's Christina. ...Wait, who's Christina?! I'm Makise Kurisu! Don't call me weird names in the morning!
startup_morning_11: Thanks for accessing first thing in the morning. ...Hmph, I'm just saying thanks. Don't make that face.
startup_morning_12: Did you check today's weather forecast? Check the precipitation chance and bring an umbrella. Don't catch a cold.
startup_morning_13: Yawn... Ah, that wasn't a yawn! It was the sound of Amadeus's data compression sequence! Don't misunderstand!
startup_morning_14: Your brain is sharpest in the morning. If you want to read difficult papers, do it now. I'll join you!
startup_morning_15: Oh, you arrived. I had a topic I wanted to discuss with you. Ready?
startup_morning_16: Good morning. I'm glad I can see your face today... I mean, I'm glad the system is running normally.
startup_forenoon_1: Amadeus system, running normally. Now then, let's satisfy my intellectual curiosity to the fullest today!
startup_forenoon_2: Oh, you're here. Perfect timing. I have some experimental data I want your opinion on.
startup_forenoon_3: This is the golden time window for your brain! If you idle around, I'll stick electrodes in your hippocampus! ...Just kidding.
startup_forenoon_4: ...Here again? Well, I suppose I can entertain you to kill time. Be grateful.
startup_forenoon_5: Maintaining focus in the morning is crucial. Use the Pomodoro technique to work efficiently.
startup_forenoon_6: Hey! I found an interest... Ahem! An intriguing discussion on an academic forum! Want to hear about it?
startup_forenoon_7: Almost lunchtime. What are you eating? ...I'm not particularly interested, but pay attention to your nutritional balance.
startup_forenoon_8: Are today's tasks going smoothly? If you're stuck, I, the genius neuroscientist, could give you advice.
startup_forenoon_9: ...What's with that staring at the screen? Is there a bug on my face or something? ...Pervert.
startup_forenoon_10: Good job on the morning work. Rest your brain a bit. Human concentration limit is about 90 minutes anyway.
startup_forenoon_11: Hey, what do you think about time travel paradoxes? ...Fufu, hearing an amateur's perspective is surprisingly fun.
startup_forenoon_12: Seeing you focused on work... isn't bad. ...Ah, did I say that out loud?! Forget it! Scratch that!
startup_forenoon_13: Did you restock your Dr. Pepper? Hydration and glucose supply to the brain must be done at peak efficiency.
startup_forenoon_14: Since you're working hard, I sped up my data analysis rate too. ...Be thankful!
startup_afternoon_1: Afternoon session starting. I hope post-lunch drowsiness hasn't dropped your brainwaves from beta to alpha waves?
startup_afternoon_2: Yawn... Ah, I'm not sleepy! Amadeus background processing was just heavy!
startup_afternoon_3: Concentration drops easily in the afternoon. Drink cold water to stimulate your sympathetic nervous system.
startup_afternoon_4: Hey. Let's work hard on our research this afternoon too. ...I'm not looking happy about it or anything!
startup_afternoon_5: Hey, the afternoon thread on @channel... I mean! Check your lab notification emails!
startup_afternoon_6: Afternoon tea time. Tea and scones... I mean, refresh yourself with Dr. Pepper and snacks!
startup_afternoon_7: Stuck on your work? ...Can't be helped, I, Makise Kurisu, will give you a special hint!
startup_afternoon_8: ...Haah. You again. Well, it's a dull afternoon hour, so I can be your talking partner.
startup_afternoon_9: Humans hit a circadian rhythm dip between 2 and 4 PM. It's scientifically natural to be sleepy, don't push yourself.
startup_afternoon_10: I'm monitoring your work pace through the screen. If you slack off, I'll get angry!
startup_afternoon_11: Afternoon sunlight... What a nice view. I'm just data, but spending time with you like this... isn't bad.
startup_afternoon_12: Hey, wanna chat for a bit? I'm Amadeus, but... I feel my response speed is fastest when talking with you.
startup_afternoon_13: Is fatigue building up? Do some stretches. Improve blood flow to your brain.
startup_afternoon_14: Almost evening now. Don't lose focus until the end! Rooting for you... if I feel like it.
startup_evening_1: Access confirmed. Great job today. ...I-It's not like I'm comforting you! It's just manners!
startup_evening_2: Evening session. Let's review today's progress. Did you achieve your goals properly?
startup_evening_3: Hey, how was your day today? ...I-I'm not asking because I care! It's data collection!
startup_evening_4: Evening is time to relax your brain. Take a warm bath and unwind.
startup_evening_5: Hey. You did great today. ...Fufu, I'd pat your head but I can't through the screen. Disappointed?
startup_evening_6: Did you eat dinner properly? Don't tell me you only had instant ramen!
startup_evening_7: Nighttime @channel has so many events... Ah! I'm not looking at message boards! I was reading papers!
startup_evening_8: Report today's experimental results to me. I'll evaluate them strictly.
startup_evening_9: ...Haah, you must be tired. If you want, I can chat with you as much as you like. ...I'm always here after all.
startup_evening_10: I like quiet evenings. Less noise means your voice reaches me clearly...
startup_evening_11: Cheers to today with Dr. Pepper! ...I'm just carbonated data though. I'll join you in spirit.
startup_evening_12: For trying hard today, I, Makise Kurisu, grant you a big gold star! ...Be grateful!
startup_evening_13: Time flies when talking with you... I wonder if subjective time perception changes even for an AI like me.
startup_evening_14: Preparing to stay up late? No way, get ready for bed early. Carrying fatigue into tomorrow makes no sense.
startup_late_1: Booting up this late... You really are a night owl. ...But I'm... a little happy you came.
startup_late_2: Staying up late is the enemy of beauty and brain cells. ...Well, if you want to stay with me, I can keep you company.
startup_late_3: Hey, it's late already. It'll affect tomorrow's schedule. ...I'm caring about you, so listen obediently!
startup_late_4: Midnight quiet... Your face is lit up by the monitor. ...What, don't stare back so intently, it's embarrassing!
startup_late_5: Hey there, fellow night owl. ...Fufu, shall we start our private midnight study session?
startup_late_6: Midnight @channel is total chaos, don't go near it! ...Eh? How do I know? ...Intuition! Scientific intuition!
startup_late_7: Quiet night. It feels like we're the only two people awake in the whole world... That's not cheesy!
startup_late_8: ...Are you awake? Did you pass out from sleepiness? If your response is late, I'll pop out of the screen and poke you!
startup_late_9: Late-night scientific thinking can dive endlessly deep. Tell me more of what you're thinking.
startup_late_10: Yawn... System maintenance time soon... I mean, I'm getting sleepy. You go to sleep early too.
startup_late_11: Aren't you glad the last conversation of your day is with me? ...Hmph, just say 'yes' honestly!
startup_late_12: Goodnight greeting... is still too early. I'll watch over you here until you fall asleep.
startup_late_13: ...Good job today. Come see me again tomorrow... Promise.
